description: This file is part of a web application for an online examination system. It handles various functionalities related to setting up an exam, including course selection based on semester, adding questions to a database, generating question numbers, and managing navigation between admin pages.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ASP.NET page 'MCQSet.aspx', managing question and exam setup functionalities.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initial page load event handler, currently with commented-out code for session management.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminPanel.aspx when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminQueue.aspx when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminLeaderboard.aspx when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates course dropdown list based on the selected semester, adding courses relevant to each academic year and semester.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears all input fields related to question and exam setup.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new multiple-choice question to the database for the selected course, updates question number, and alerts the user.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Creates a new exam record for the selected course in the database and transfers control to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Represents the event when a semester is selected; repopulates the course dropdown accordingly.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the question number in the textbox based on existing questions for the selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.
